evals.name: check-standing-and-plan
evals.prompt: check the benchmarks — how's the local model doing on evals and what should we run next?
evals.expected_output: A grounded scorecard reading real numbers from data/eval/leaderboard.jsonl and data/longmemeval/runs.jsonl, distinguishing raw vs chat and subset vs full, set against a live SOTA search, plus a ranked 'run next' plan with exact commands. Should offer/note updating docs/BENCHMARKS.md.

evals.name: single-mark-swebench
evals.prompt: where do we stand on SWE-bench for the local coder?
evals.expected_output: Reads data/eval/swebench/ predictions and any graded leaderboard row, correctly reports that grading is Docker-outsourced and predictions may exist without a resolved-rate, contextualizes vs current SWE-bench leaderboard, and proposes the graded run command. Should not fabricate a resolved number.

evals.name: council-vs-local-honesty
evals.prompt: compare the local model to the council on honesty benchmarks and tell me what to benchmark next
evals.expected_output: Reads HaluEval/epistemic ledgers, treats the council as a verification axis (not a pass-rate), reports honestly where council outcome labels are missing, and gives a ranked next-run plan. Does not invent a council score.
